name: Hosts
description: A hosts list (This Mac and every machine with its sessions and their program status, plus Add Host), a session picker on every New Tab, a block card in Session Info, and a status-line hover card.

scopes.agent_chat:read: Read your agent chats, to list each host's sessions with their status.
scopes.workspace:read: Know which workspace is open, to mark its session; read the hovered workspace's facts.
scopes.workspace:write: Show a session's workspace when you click it.
scopes.actions:run: Add a host, start a session, or open a session in a tab.
